items.title: Claude Duet Safety, Privacy, and Security
items.content: Claude Duet is a proactive agent that works for you, even while you’re away. It builds on two layers of protection: safety training in the Claude model itself and the safeguards that exist in products like Claude Code and Claude Managed Agents. On top of those, we added new protections for working across your accounts and acting on your behalf.
items.contentSnippet: Claude Duet is a proactive agent that works for you, even while you’re away. It builds on two layers of protection: safety training in the Claude model itself and the safeguards that exist in products like Claude Code and Claude Managed Agents. On top of those, we added new protections for working across your accounts and acting on your behalf.

summaries.zh: Claude Duet是一款能在用户离线时仍主动工作的智能代理。它基于Claude模型的安全训练和Claude Code、Claude Managed Agents等产品中的保护措施，构建了双重安全防护。此外，还增加了跨账户协作和代为执行任务的新防护机制，以提升安全性。
summaries.en: Claude Duet is a proactive agent designed to operate independently, even when users are absent. It incorporates dual layers of protection: safety training within the Claude model and existing safeguards in products like Claude Code and Claude Managed Agents. Additional new safeguards have been implemented to enhance cross-account collaboration and authorized actions on behalf of users. The system prioritizes security, privacy, and user control through these combined measures.

items.summary: Claude Duet是一款能在用户离线时仍主动工作的智能代理。它基于Claude模型的安全训练和Claude Code、Claude Managed Agents等产品中的保护措施，构建了双重安全防护。此外，还增加了跨账户协作和代为执行任务的新防护机制，以提升安全性。

items.title: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at a much larger scale
items.content: We need ways to prove that code is free of bugs. Formal software verification could provide this guarantee.
items.contentSnippet: We need ways to prove that code is free of bugs. Formal software verification could provide this guarantee.

summaries.zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）使大规模形式化软件验证成为可能。形式化软件验证能够为代码无错误提供保证。
summaries.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are enabling formal software verification at a larger scale, addressing the need to prove code is free of bugs. Formal verification traditionally faces scalability challenges, but LLMs help overcome these limitations, making it more feasible to ensure software reliability. The approach leverages LLM capabilities to enhance the verification process, offering a promising solution for bug-free code assurance.

items.summary: 大型语言模型（LLMs）使大规模形式化软件验证成为可能。形式化软件验证能够为代码无错误提供保证。

items.title: Redesigning source control at Anthropic
items.content: As merges to Anthropic's monorepo grew from about 2,500 to more than 30,000 a day, source control became the biggest development bottleneck. Here is how the team built Scion, an in-house version control system designed for always-online agents, and migrated off git in five months.
items.contentSnippet: As merges to Anthropic's monorepo grew from about 2,500 to more than 30,000 a day, source control became the biggest development bottleneck. Here is how the team built Scion, an in-house version control system designed for always-online agents, and migrated off git in five months.

summaries.zh: Anthropic的单一代码库合并请求量从每天约2,500个激增至超过30,000个，导致源代码管理成为最大的开发瓶颈。团队为此开发了内部版本控制系统Scion，专为常在线代理设计，并在五个月内成功从Git迁移。Scion解决了合并请求激增的问题，提升了开发效率。
summaries.en: Anthropic's monorepo experienced a surge in daily merges from 2,500 to over 30,000, making source control a major bottleneck. To address this, the team developed Scion, an in-house version control system tailored for always-online agents, and successfully migrated away from Git in five months.

items.summary: Anthropic的单一代码库合并请求量从每天约2,500个激增至超过30,000个，导致源代码管理成为最大的开发瓶颈。团队为此开发了内部版本控制系统Scion，专为常在线代理设计，并在五个月内成功从Git迁移。Scion解决了合并请求激增的问题，提升了开发效率。

items.title: Automating eval design and hillclimbing with Claude
items.content: Principles for designing evals and hillclimbing against them without fooling yourself, and how the claude-api skill's build-eval and hillclimb commands put them to work.
items.contentSnippet: Principles for designing evals and hillclimbing against them without fooling yourself, and how the claude-api skill's build-eval and hillclimb commands put them to work.

summaries.en: The article discusses principles for designing evaluation metrics (evals) and hillclimbing optimization without bias. items.title: How Comcast and Booz Allen use Claude Mythos to find exploit chains and secure their codebases
items.content: Security teams at Comcast and Booz Allen used Claude Mythos-class models through Project Glasswing to find, validate, and fix vulnerabilities their existing scanners missed.
items.contentSnippet: Security teams at Comcast and Booz Allen used Claude Mythos-class models through Project Glasswing to find, validate, and fix vulnerabilities their existing scanners missed.

summaries.zh: 康卡斯特和博思艾伦通过“玻璃翼”项目使用Claude Mythos高级模型，识别并验证了现有扫描器遗漏的漏洞，从而增强了其代码库的安全性。
summaries.en: Comcast and Booz Allen security teams utilized Claude Mythos-class models via Project Glasswing to identify, validate, and remediate vulnerabilities overlooked by standard scanners. The models helped secure their codebases by uncovering exploit chains. This approach enhanced their vulnerability detection capabilities.

items.title: Claude now works with Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides
items.content: Teams that run on Google Workspace can now bring Claude into their files or work on their files directly from Claude, with our new add-on and Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides connectors (in beta).
items.contentSnippet: Teams that run on Google Workspace can now bring Claude into their files or work on their files directly from Claude, with our new add-on and Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides connectors (in beta).

summaries.zh: Claude现与Google Docs、Sheets和Slides合作。通过新的插件和Google套件连接器（测试版），Google Workspace团队可直接在文件中引入Claude，或从Claude端处理文件。
summaries.en: Claude has integrated with Google Workspace, allowing teams to use it within Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides via a new add-on and connectors (currently in beta). Users can now bring Claude into their files or work on files directly from Claude, enhancing collaboration and productivity within Google's suite of tools.
